title: Binding
summary: Official Derivative reference for binding, a bidirectional parameter mode that links parameters, table cells, Bind CHOP channels, panel values, dependency objects, and object attributes through bind masters, references, chains, and bind tuples.
guidance: Use this article when two or more controls must stay synchronized bidirectionally instead of one driving the other by export or expression.
When setting up by dragging, drag the bind master to the reference so the generated relationship preserves the documented direction.
A bind reference does not use its constant, expression, or export modes; its bind expression resolves to the master.
Bind masters can have expressions or exports, but if changed by references they may enter constant mode.
For custom menu parameters, use menuSource to duplicate the source menu options before binding values.
Use bind tuples such as (op('text1'), 'text') when binding to object attributes rather than normal parameter objects.
